verdict.rationale: Appwrite provides an official CLI (hands-on verified to install via npm and run headlessly with appwrite-cli --version) that can manage projects, resources, and deploy Functions, plus self-hosting via Docker for full CI/automation control and a documented --endpoint flag for scripting against self-hosted instances. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/recipe (e.g., GitHub Actions) in evidence, and no independent third-party report of CI usage beyond the hands-on CLI probe.
